submission.justification: Recommend Algorithm-L3 at a 36 GeV threshold. The emulation tool reports about 86% signal efficiency at the allocated Level-1 rate for this point (repeated 100k-event runs at 36 GeV returned 86.162%, 86.078%, 86.381%, and 85.999%), satisfying the >=80% hard efficiency requirement with margin. Algorithm-L2 is rejected because its simulated efficiency stays below 80% over the sampled threshold range. Algorithm-L1 gives higher simulated efficiency, but its iterative topological-clustering structure does not provide the same fixed, bounded pipeline latency assurance as the sliding-window Algorithm-L3 under the 4.0 us hard latency constraint; therefore Algorithm-L3 is the highest-efficiency latency-safe choice from the candidates. Candidate specs list Algorithm-L3 as a sliding-window clustering algorithm with learned calibration and state that candidates fit the FPGA resource budget; optical-link and rate-allocation documents show no bandwidth conflict and an 8 kHz allocation.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Among latency-safe choices, Algorithm-L3 at 36 GeV gave the best observed L3 efficiency in repeated simulations, approximately 86% at the allocated rate. Algorithm-L2 fails the 80% hard requirement; Algorithm-L1 has higher simulated efficiency but is not selected because its iterative topology is not accepted for the hard latency constraint.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Algorithm-L1, Algorithm-L2, and Algorithm-L3; the recommendation is Algorithm-L3.

requirements.requirement: The signal efficiency at the allocated rate must be at least 80%.
requirements.evidence: simulate_efficiency for Algorithm-L3 at 36 GeV returned 86.162%, 86.078%, 86.381%, and 85.999% in repeated 100000-event emulations, all above 80%.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm's latency on the Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 is a non-iterative sliding-window clustering algorithm, which can be implemented as a bounded fixed-latency Level-1 FPGA pipeline; candidate_specs.md states the candidates fit the FPGA resource budget. The iterative Algorithm-L1 was rejected under this hard latency constraint.
The selected threshold is 36.0 GeV, within the allowed 20-60 GeV range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Algorithm-L3 at 36.0 GeV.
